name: Haravan to Zalo Daily Report
description: Fetch recent Haravan orders with an encrypted bearer token, summarize them locally, and post a daily message to an authorized Zalo OA delivery adapter endpoint.

config_schema.label: Haravan orders URL
config_schema.description: Haravan Admin API orders endpoint. You can add supported query parameters to narrow the reporting window.

config_schema.label: Zalo OA delivery adapter URL
config_schema.description: HTTPS endpoint you are authorized to use for Zalo OA delivery. Goflow posts recipient_id and message to this adapter.

config_schema.label: Zalo recipient ID
config_schema.description: Recipient identifier expected by your authorized Zalo OA delivery adapter.

config_schema.label: Report language
config_schema.description: Language used in the summary message.

credential_requirements.label: Haravan access token
credential_requirements.description: Encrypted bearer token for an authorized Haravan app with the required order-read permission.

credential_requirements.label: Zalo adapter access token
credential_requirements.description: Encrypted bearer token expected by your authorized Zalo OA delivery adapter.
